strings.Все участники и документы дела вымышлены: All participants and documents are fictional. Application of the simplified procedure under Article 221.1 of the Russian Tax Code is established. An admissible application is signed and submitted, with sufficient information. There is no decision to extend review, and no exceptions to the standard period apply. You prepare materials and proposed actions rather than replace an authorised person's decision. The submitted application under the simplified procedure. No extension or special exceptions apply. Counting rules for this exercise: from the day after the event; a non-working final day is moved forward; the federal five-day working week applies.
